name: Keyboard Layout Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: Switch keyboard layouts from the Omarchy bar or a shortcut, and type from a clickable on-screen keyboard.

barWidget.description: Shows the active keyboard layout. Click it to switch layouts or open the keyboard viewer.

schema.label: Bar Appearance
schema.description: Show the layout code as a filled icon, an outlined icon, or plain text.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Bar
schema.description: Show the full layout name next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Show Emojis in Menu
schema.description: Add a menu item that opens Omarchy's Emojis picker.

schema.label: Show Keyboard Viewer in Menu
schema.description: Add a menu item that opens the clickable keyboard viewer.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Menu
schema.description: Add a menu item that toggles the layout name in the bar.

schema.label: Show Keyboard Settings in Menu
schema.description: Add a menu item that opens ~/.config/hypr/input.lua in your editor.

schema.label: Keyboard Viewer Shape (Advanced)
schema.description: The key arrangement the viewer draws. Auto picks one from your layout and keyboard model.
